name: ati-monorepo
description: Monorepo orquestrador do ecossistema ATI (Extensão do Chrome e Painel Web)

scripts.clean: npm run clean:extension && npm run clean:site
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:site
scripts.lint: npm run lint:extension && npm run lint:site
scripts.format: npm run format:extension && npm run format:site
scripts.build:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run build --prefix "Extension"
scripts.zip:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run zip --prefix "Extension"
scripts.release:extension: npm run clean:extension && npm run release --prefix "Extension"
scripts.build:site: npm run clean:site && npm run build --prefix "Frontend"

author: Vituali
